task: Add exemption gate for Dependabot GitHub Action bumps to avoid high-risk operational trace failures on automated dependency bumps

events.summary: Scoped change to CI workflow, CI scripts, tests, and trace artifact for Dependabot action bump exemption without modifying unrelated platform components
Confirmed Dependabot action bump failure on PR #210 where ruby/setup-ruby bump was blocked by high-risk operational trace requirement
Added scripts/ci/check-dependabot-action-bump.py, switched fnmatch to fnmatchcase in check-agent-trace-evidence.py, and gated trace requirement steps in agent-behavior.yml

Ran unittest suite covering single and multi-file bumps, non-matching lines, ref changes, SHA mismatches, malformed tag comments, non-workflow files, empty diffs, resolver errors, added run lines, and indentation changes
Verified script on PR #210 base/head SHAs yielding exempt: true, compiled python scripts with py_compile, validated agent-behavior.yml with yaml.safe_load, and passed mutable input check
Dependabot GitHub Action bump exemption check and workflow gating are implemented and verified

Ran the script on PR #210 (merge-base..head) with the real network resolver: exempt=true, rc=0; git ls-remote https://github.com/ruby/setup-ruby refs/tags/v1.324.0 returned a0102e0972be65f351c307e2d64b9314a57c8073, equal to the pinned SHA. Workflow now diffs from git merge-base(base.sha, head.sha) because a two-dot diff against a moved main carries main's own changes and would never qualify. actionlint and yaml.safe_load pass on agent-behavior.yml; check-agent-trace-requirement.py rc=0 and check-agent-trace-evidence.py passed=true on this branch's changed files.
evidence: test:python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/ci/tests (11 tests OK)
